# Local GDScript derivative

All 75 original files and their license remain exact under upstream/; inert Git
attribute/ignore names are recorded in SOURCE-PROVENANCE.json. The parser tables
are unchanged. active-src contains the separately reviewed checked-state scanner
and its mandatory request-status header and implementation unit. The Cargo
wrapper uses exact local tree-sitter-language and cc inputs and compiles parser,
scanner, and status unit together; all three have rebuild triggers.

The source inventory binds the exact C boundary test source, not a claim that
its tests ran. Pristine syntax observations do not qualify this scanner.
